de9923a710.q: What problem did Davisware solve for HVAC and trade service industries?
de9923a710.a: Davisware solved the core logistical challenge in the trades: getting the right person to the right place at the right time with the right parts and skills. They built dispatch board software integrated with billing, inventory, GPS, accounting, and CPA-compliant systems with 30 modules total. Their predictive analytics matched technician skillsets and likely parts to customer problems, enabling first-time fixes and reducing truck inventory by 50% while improving staff efficiency from 1-to-1 office-to-field ratios down to 3-to-1 or 4-to-1.

beef71d2be.q: What were the three main industries that Davisware focused on besides HVAC?
